assertion_control.method: Exact full-file inverse and balanced complete check-call extraction, not an installed GDScript AST parser. Full-byte equality of all check expressions preserves their syntax/AST by construction.

baseline.behavior_difference: Baseline ShotLatch/GameAudio selected first global audio group. P7 commit317b755c deliberately changed both to nearest ancestry owner; current sibling fixture is unowned and intentionally falls back. Do not label this as the same original2ce native failure.

labels: Actual projectile collision commits one opening and one dedicated chime
Accepted mechanism uses the new source in the unchanged shared pool

topology.before: SceneTree.root -> App -> selected GameAudio; separate root -> fixture world -> ShotLatch. for_origin searches only ancestor/direct-child scopes, never inside sibling App, thus fallback.
topology.after: SceneTree.root -> App -> selected GameAudio + fixture world -> ShotLatch. Nearest owner now is the already asserted formal selected GameAudio.
topology.geometry: App root is Node2D with default identity transform in demo.tscn and no own transform writes in App entry path. Existing fixture local offset10000,6000 and all player/floor/latch coordinates unchanged.
topology.pause: App PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS requires explicit fixture PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE to retain the prior inherited root-world pause behavior.
topology.teardown: Original order unchanged: drain_world(world), world.free(), drain_world(app), app.free(). Child is gone before parent drain/free; no double-free or stale await introduced.
